{{Top|leg}}
A '''Pawning Table''' was a slab-like pedestal made of [[meltmassif]]. It was used to turn [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Cronal|Shadowspawn's]] prisoners into [[Pawn]]s. Pawns would use their [[neural stunner]]s to liquefy a coffin-sized area in the smooth stone into a fluid stone that was the consistency of cold [[Barkmeal/Legends|barkmeal]]. They would then place a stunned prisoner inside the liquid stone until only the individual's head was exposed. From there, they would be slowly turned into Pawns after much tinkering with their [[Brain/Legends|brains]].
